lineage.rule: DBF-1 and DBF-1.1 stay immutable history; DBF-1.2 supersedes DBF-1.1 only as the active integrated preliminary-design baseline

status_semantics.meaning: architecture / design parameters frozen at preliminary-design level; measured compliance open to EM / QM testing; open verification items do not unfreeze the baseline

authority_rule: this JSON is authoritative; DBF1_2_v1.md restates it; dbf1_2_config_v1.json is the machine-readable subset; all pinned by dbf1_2_lock_v1.json
source_rule: only values or candidates already in the repository (A9.37); no invented physics; where evidence is incomplete the selected engineering assumption is frozen with its evidence class and uncertainty; DBF-1.2 values are read from pinned records by the builder, not retyped

status_vocabulary.FROZEN: the value is frozen as the design value; its evidence supports it at the stated class
status_vocabulary.FROZEN_ASSUMPTION: the value is frozen as the selected engineering assumption; the evidence is incomplete and the class / uncertainty say how (A9.37: never left open)
status_vocabulary.REFERENCE_PENDING_ICD: a frozen reference value standing in for a customer / host ICD that does not exist; replaced only by that ICD through a DCR
status_vocabulary.BASELINE_DEFICIENCY: the value is frozen (it is the design) and a registered closure condition is known not to be met by it; the deficiency record gives the numbers. Not a reason to keep trading (A9.37)
status_vocabulary.SUPERSEDED_BY_DCR_DBF1_001: a DBF-1.1 item replaced by its DBF-1.2 successor (kept for traceability)
status_vocabulary.INHERITED_UNCHANGED: a DBF-1.1 item carried unchanged (value copied from the pinned DBF-1.1 record)

evidence_attributes.evidence_class: plain-language class (owner-fixed / literature / model-derived / engineering assumption / reference pending ICD)
